reported_status: P2 constructs a conditional nine-state captured-cam joint organization and common-base writer for the full ten-zone geometric class, with analytical ideal access bounds, introduced structural screens, a continuous observation-based100-attempt rehearsal and a matched unfavorable service comparison. Manufactured accuracy, contact life, full writer and whole advantage remain unqualified. Queued ROOT notes add separate continuous-laminate shear transfer, catalytic rest-metric writing/retention, ordered framed-rod mechanics and fabrication/clearing contracts. They do not supply one common material or compatible apparatus.
